entities.summary: Ihor Anatoliivych Skybiuk is a Ukrainian Air Assault Forces major general involved in the Russo-Ukrainian war. He had been the commander of the Air Assault Forces since 2023 to 2025, and a recipient of the title Hero of Ukraine and a knight of the Order of Bohdan Khmelnytsky.
